mapper.select: select l.id,l.account_id,l.super_admin_id,l.role_code,l.operation_type,l.target,l.content,l.create_time,a.login_name,sa.login_name as super_admin_name from external_operation_log l join external_manager_account a on a.id=l.account_id left join external_manager_account sa on sa.id=l.super_admin_id and a.login_name like concat('%',#{loginName},'%')and sa.login_name like concat('%',#{superAdminName},'%')and l.operation_type=#{operationType}and l.create_time >= #{beginTime}and l.create_time <= #{endTime} order by l.id desc
mapper.delete: delete from external_operation_log where operation_type='CREATE_SUBORDINATE' and target=#{target}
mapper.select: select count(1) from external_operation_log where account_id=#{accountId} and operation_type=#{operationType} and create_time >= curdate()
